engineering_objective: Complete an enterprise PII discovery system whose Go control plane coordinates policy-pinned scans and whose Java workers inspect heterogeneous synthetic corporate data, producing privacy-safe, restart-safe findings and reports.

distinctive_center: Java multi-format content scanner with contextual and checksum-backed PII detection
Go scan-job, lease, policy, report, and recovery control plane
privacy-safe evidence fingerprints and masked excerpts
excluded: automatic deletion, quarantine, or remediation of source data

java_scanner: CSV, JSON, NDJSON, XML, properties, email, and text extraction
email, phone, SSN, payment card, IBAN, passport, tax ID, date-of-birth, address, and name-context detectors
privacy-safe evidence masking and HMAC fingerprinting
integration: policy digest and scan generation fencing
signed report manifest and stable JSON/CSV summaries

operational_requirements: Inventory only configured source roots and reject traversal, symlink escape, unsupported file type, and oversized-resource violations safely.
Parse heterogeneous structured and unstructured records while preserving canonical source, record, field, and byte/line provenance.
Detect multiple PII categories using normalization, validation, checksums, context, confidence thresholds, allowlists, and suppression rules rather than regex matches alone.
Never persist raw detected values; store only category, masked evidence, keyed fingerprint, location, confidence, detector revision, and policy provenance.
Keep exact repeated values linkable within an authorized scan scope without making fingerprints comparable across unrelated tenants or policy key epochs.
Pin every job and shard to an immutable policy version, detector bundle, corpus snapshot, and scan generation.
Fence worker leases by worker session, attempt, deadline, shard, policy digest, and generation so stale workers cannot commit results.
Make retries, duplicate batches, reconnects, checkpoint resume, cancellation, and finalization idempotent.
Isolate malformed files and records with bounded errors while continuing adjacent valid content.
Apply byte, record, nesting, archive, match, error, memory, and time budgets deterministically and report truncation explicitly.
Deduplicate overlapping chunk matches and repeated ingestion without collapsing distinct locations or independently governed sources.
Aggregate findings by category, confidence, source, department, region, policy, and remediation priority from one complete committed generation.
Apply source and department authorization before rows, counts, facets, deduplication groups, examples, pagination, exports, and totals.
Publish stable JSON and CSV reports with deterministic ordering, schemas, manifests, digests, completeness state, and policy provenance.
Do not publish a successful complete report until every required shard is committed, explicitly skipped by policy, or terminally failed under the documented completion rules.
Persist jobs, leases, checkpoints, result batches, report generations, audit events, and source fences atomically with safe fallback after restart.
Retain bounded report generations and audit history without deleting state referenced by active jobs, exports, or recovery.
Expose bounded status, readiness, metrics, errors, worker, policy, finding, and report APIs without leaking raw source content or PII.
Operate deterministically offline against a generated 10,000-20,000-record synthetic corporate corpus and never mutate source data.

root_cause_clusters.RC_SOURCE_BOUNDARIES: Source traversal, canonical identity, parsing, provenance, and malformed-record isolation disagree across formats.
root_cause_clusters.RC_DETECTION_SEMANTICS: Normalization, validation, context, confidence, allowlists, and overlap resolution do not form one detector contract.
root_cause_clusters.RC_EVIDENCE_PRIVACY: Masking, keyed fingerprints, deduplication, and report examples can expose or incorrectly link sensitive values.
root_cause_clusters.RC_JOB_AUTHORITY: Policy pins, generations, worker sessions, leases, retries, checkpoints, and cancellation are insufficiently fenced.
root_cause_clusters.RC_REPORT_COMPLETENESS: Batch ingestion, aggregation, authorization, finalization, ordering, and exports can observe partial or unauthorized state.
root_cause_clusters.RC_RECOVERY_RETENTION: Atomic persistence, restart fallback, resume, and retention do not preserve referenced state and accepted authority.
root_cause_clusters.RC_RESOURCE_OPERABILITY: Budgets, bounded telemetry, readiness, health, and degraded-source reporting diverge from actual scan progress.

defects.observable_failure: Symlink or relative-path traversal escapes an approved source root.
Equivalent paths or case variants create duplicate sources while distinct archive members collapse.
CSV quoting, nested JSON, XML text, or email headers lose field-level provenance.
One malformed record aborts its file or source instead of producing a bounded error.
BOM, invalid UTF-8, or split multibyte input changes offsets or suppresses adjacent valid text.
Formatted and Unicode-equivalent PII values receive inconsistent validation and identity.
Digit-like values are reported as payment cards without length, issuer, and Luhn validation.
SSN, passport, tax ID, phone, and IBAN patterns ignore country and contextual boundaries.
Negative context, positive labels, and confidence thresholds are applied after finding publication.
Chunk boundaries and overlapping detectors duplicate or discard the wrong finding.
Allowlist scope, expiry, category, and policy version are ignored or applied globally.
Short or structured values reveal too many characters or produce unstable masking.
Unkeyed or globally keyed fingerprints enable cross-tenant comparison.
Repeated ingestion duplicates one location or collapses separate governed locations.
Examples, errors, logs, or exports include raw matched values or surrounding sensitive text.
A policy update changes already-created job or shard semantics.
Expired, replaced-session, wrong-attempt, or wrong-generation workers commit result batches.
Exact batch retry changes totals while conflicting reuse of a batch identity is accepted.
Resume skips uncommitted records or reprocesses committed records with duplicate side effects.
Cancelled jobs continue leasing shards or publish a complete report.
A report is marked complete while required shards are missing, active, or only partially committed.
Rows are filtered after counts, facets, examples, dedupe groups, cursors, or exports leak hidden sources.
Malformed, truncated, suppressed, and skipped states are counted as ordinary findings or omitted from completeness.
Map iteration, equal sort keys, or CSV escaping makes report bytes and digests nondeterministic.
CURRENT points to an unverified job, result, or report generation after interruption.
Recovery selects newest rather than highest valid generation or forgets lease and policy fences.
Cleanup deletes policy, result, report, or audit state referenced by active work or export leases.
Budget exhaustion is silent, queues and labels grow unbounded, or readiness is true before recovery and required workers are current.

cross_component: budget state in reports and readiness

data_volume_plan: Generate 12,000-18,000 deterministic synthetic records across HR, finance, legal, support, sales, engineering, and vendor sources; include clean controls, valid and invalid candidates, repeated governed values, malformed records, multiple formats, regional policies, and no real personal data.
substantive_loc_plan: Target 4,500-7,000 reachable Java, Go, shell, and configuration LOC; never count generated corpus, tests, docs, vendor code, or duplicated detectors toward the floor.
